evidence: Directly modifies TxIndex::FindTx in src/index/txindex.cpp to throw an exception on disk read failures or corruption instead of returning null.
rationale: Silently returning not-found on index corruption or I/O failure masks data integrity issues in txindex. As commit fa5c96a112 notes, 'a -txindex corruption may also point to a larger system corruption and it seems better to notify the user properly by throwing an exception.'
